gloss_en: I took the car to the garage after work
notes: [automotive] garage→[ɡaːradʒ]: PROBE RESULT — the ǧīm-lenition ج→[j] is a GRAPHEME rule on Arabic script and does NOT reach the loan-internal [dʒ], which nativisation inserts directly as a donor phoneme (final /ʒ/→[dʒ]). So garage keeps a hard [dʒ] even though native جديد→[jaˈdiːd] lenites — the interaction the brief asked to document. native عَقُب → [ʕaɡub], ق→[ɡ] (johnstone1967). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: my mobile is lost
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested Gulf [moːbaːjil] with the mid vowel [oː] (Holes 2004). PIPELINE WRONG: emits [almuːbaːjil] — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid [oː], and misplaces stress inside the length mark ([almuˈːbaːjil]). Correct loan IPA pinned; unlike Rijāl Almaʿ, Sharqiyya HAS [oː], so [uː] is genuinely wrong here. native ض ضَاع → [dˤ] (Gulf, no laterals). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: see you tomorrow, God willing
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Gulf Arabic; baachir 'tomorrow' written with č (=[tʃ], the kaf-affricated *bākir), NOT j — the blind-round preference. Spells أَشُوفَك بَاچِر إِنْ شَاءَ الله. ipa hand-derived: [baːtʃir]. NOTE: the diacritizer corrupts a medial چ (بَاچِر→[baˈːir], dropping the affricate), so this correct form cannot round-trip through transcribe — a documented pipeline limitation, which is why the row is unsupported not pinned. table: n/a
